name: dobrokonep
description: Dobrovolnický systém – Dobrovolnické centrum (Google Apps Script + GitHub Pages)

scripts.kontrola: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const k=['Kod','Dashboard','Hodiny','Portal','Zalohy','Api'].map(f=>fs.readFileSync('apps-script/'+f+'.gs','utf8')).join('\n');new Function(k);console.log('Apps Script: syntaxe OK')"
scripts.test: npm run kontrola && node testy/poradi-souboru.js && node testy/backend-vykaz.js && node testy/backend-hodiny.js && node testy/backend-portal.js && node testy/backend-zalohy.js
